summary: <2-3 sentences: what works, the biggest problem, the cost of not fixing it. Quote the page.>

ux.primary_cta.rationale: <one line. Pass = One visually dominant primary CTA sits in the first viewport, its label names the action, and it keeps the visitor on the site.>

ux.cta_fidelity.rationale: <one line. Pass = Every CTA lands on content that delivers what its label promises (an assessment opens an assessment, 'Learn more about X' opens X).>

ux.conversion_path.rationale: <one line. Pass = A ready buyer can convert on-site in two steps or fewer, e.g. an embedded scheduler or a short form with an instant confirmation.>

ux.navigation.rationale: <one line. Pass = The main nav has 7 or fewer plainly worded items, each leading to a real destination, and the current location is clear.>

ux.persuasion_flow.rationale: <one line. Pass = Sections run hook -> problem -> offer -> proof -> objection handling -> CTA, with a CTA placed right after the strongest proof.>

ux.visual_hierarchy.rationale: <one line. Pass = One consistent button system (primary/secondary/text), a clear type scale, and repeated components look and behave the same.>

ux.responsive.rationale: <one line. Pass = One fluid DOM serves every breakpoint, a viewport meta tag is set, and there is no horizontal scroll at 375px.>

ux.accessibility.rationale: <one line. Pass = Images have meaningful alt text, html has a lang attribute, a skip link exists, inputs have labels and text contrast looks adequate.>

seo.indexable_architecture.rationale: <one line. Pass = Each core service or offer has its own crawlable URL with unique copy, and the nav links to those URLs.>

seo.title_meta.rationale: <one line. Pass = The title (under 60 chars) names the brand and the category keyword, and a unique 120-160 char meta description states the offer.>

seo.headings.rationale: <one line. Pass = Exactly one H1 holds the core keyword theme, and H2/H3s follow in a logical outline with no duplicated headings.>

seo.image_alt.rationale: <one line. Pass = 90% or more of content images have descriptive, context-specific alt text, and logos carry the brand name.>

seo.structured_data.rationale: <one line. Pass = Valid JSON-LD for Organization plus the page-relevant types (Service, FAQPage, Person, Product, Article) is present.>

seo.internal_linking.rationale: <one line. Pass = Pages link to related service, case-study and blog pages with descriptive anchor text, and nothing important is orphaned.>

seo.technical.rationale: <one line. Pass = HTTPS, a self-referencing canonical, robots.txt and an XML sitemap, Open Graph tags, and no noindex on public pages.>

content.value_prop.rationale: <one line. Pass = Within 5 seconds the hero says who it is for, what they get and why this provider is different.>

content.audience_pain.rationale: <one line. Pass = The copy names the target audience's specific problems in their own language.>

content.offer_specificity.rationale: <one line. Pass = Each offer states deliverables, format and who it suits, plus a pricing or engagement-model signal (from-price, tiers, retainer or project).>

content.proof_depth.rationale: <one line. Pass = At least one case study gives the client context, the intervention and a measurable before/after outcome.>

content.freshness.rationale: <one line. Pass = The blog or resources have dated content from the last 90 days, published regularly.>

content.readability_voice.rationale: <one line. Pass = Copy is scannable (short paragraphs, descriptive subheads, plain words) and the voice stays consistent and distinct.>

trust.claim_substantiation.rationale: <one line. Pass = Every statistic or performance claim shows its source, sample or method (footnote, link or 'based on N clients').>

trust.social_proof.rationale: <one line. Pass = Testimonials carry a full name, title and organisation, and client logos are recognisable and named in alt text or captions.>

trust.founder_team.rationale: <one line. Pass = Named people with photos, relevant credentials and verifiable history (LinkedIn, past employers, certifications).>

trust.maintenance.rationale: <one line. Pass = The copyright year is current, there are no broken links or console errors, and no placeholder or 'coming soon' content.>

trust.contact_legitimacy.rationale: <one line. Pass = Direct contact details (email or phone, a location), privacy policy and terms are linked, and there are active social profiles beyond one channel.>
